snippet.title: Blades of Fire - Official Character Breakdown - FGS Live From gamescom latam
snippet.description:
Acclaimed Spanish developer MercurySteam shared a selection of new characters from their upcoming action adventure Blades of Fire during the FGS LIve From gamescom latam 2025 showcase. Protagonist Aran de Lira must confront his former childhood friend, the evil queen Nerea, whose paths have diverged after a tragic event. We meet young Adso, who will offer support on his quest, analysing enemies to reveal new combat strategies. In this new action-action-adventure from MercurySteam you forge your own weapons and face fierce enemies in a unique combat system. Coming to PS5, Xbox and PC (Epic store) on May 22, 2025.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow
